# Sample size calculation for proportion estimation
# Using normal approximation with specified margin of error

# Parameters
p <- 0.70  # target proportion
ME <- 0.03  # margin of error (half-width of CI)
z_critical <- 1.96  # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile

# Formula: n = (z^2 * p * (1-p)) / ME^2
n_exact <- (z_critical^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (ME^2)

# Round upward to next integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

# Display results
cat("Proportion Precision Calculation\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("Margin of error (ME):", ME, "\n")
cat("Confidence level: 95% (two-sided)\n")
cat("Critical z-value (97.5th percentile):", z_critical, "\n\n")
cat("Formula: n = (z^2 × p × (1-p)) / ME^2\n\n")
cat("Numerator (z^2 × p × (1-p)):", z_critical^2 * p * (1 - p), "\n")
cat("Denominator (ME^2):", ME^2, "\n")
cat("Exact sample size (n):", n_exact, "\n")
cat("Rounded upward (ceiling):", n_rounded, "\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved margin of error at rounded sample size
ME_achieved <- z_critical * sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n_rounded)
cat("\nVerification at n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Achieved margin of error:", ME_achieved, "\n")
cat("Target margin of error:", ME, "\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("\n\nFinal Result:\n")
print(results)

# Emit structured result
library(jsonlite)
result_json <- toJSON(list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_rounded, unit = "participants_total")
  )
), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", result_json, "\n")

# Independent verification of proportion precision calculation
# Using the standard formula: n = (z^2 * p * (1-p)) / ME^2

# Parameters from the request
p <- 0.70          # target proportion
ME <- 0.03         # margin of error (half-width)
z_critical <- 1.96 # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile

# Step 1: Compute exact sample size
p_times_q <- p * (1 - p)  # p(1-p) = variance factor
z_squared <- z_critical^2  # z^2

n_exact <- (z_squared * p_times_q) / (ME^2)

cat("Independent Verification of Proportion Precision Calculation\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
cat("Given parameters:\n")
cat("  p (target proportion):", p, "\n")
cat("  ME (margin of error):", ME, "\n")
cat("  z (critical value):", z_critical, "\n")
cat("  Confidence level: 95% (two-sided, α=0.05)\n\n")

cat("Calculation steps:\n")
cat("  z^2 =", z_squared, "\n")
cat("  p(1-p) =", p, "×", (1-p), "=", p_times_q, "\n")
cat("  ME^2 =", ME^2, "\n")
cat("  n = (z^2 × p(1-p)) / ME^2\n")
cat("  n = (", z_squared, "×", p_times_q, ") /", ME^2, "\n")
cat("  n =", z_squared * p_times_q, "/", ME^2, "\n")
cat("  n =", n_exact, "\n\n")

# Step 2: Round upward (ceiling)
n_final <- ceiling(n_exact)
cat("Rounding upward (ceiling function):\n")
cat("  n_final =", n_final, "\n\n")

# Step 3: Verify achieved margin of error at final sample size
se_achieved <- sqrt((p * (1-p)) / n_final)
ME_achieved <- z_critical * se_achieved

cat("Verification of achieved margin of error at n =", n_final, ":\n")
cat("  SE = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) = sqrt(", p_times_q, "/", n_final, ") =", se_achieved, "\n")
cat("  ME_achieved = z × SE =", z_critical, "×", se_achieved, "=", ME_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Target ME:", ME, "\n")
cat("  Achieved ME ≤ Target ME?", ME_achieved <= ME, "\n\n")

# Step 4: Check if n-1 would have been sufficient (verify upward rounding was necessary)
n_minus_1 <- n_final - 1
se_minus_1 <- sqrt((p * (1-p)) / n_minus_1)
ME_minus_1 <- z_critical * se_minus_1

cat("Check rounding decision (would n-1 =", n_minus_1, "suffice?):\n")
cat("  ME at n-1 =", ME_minus_1, "\n")
cat("  Would meet target (ME ≤", ME, ")?", ME_minus_1 <= ME, "\n\n")

# Final output
cat("CONCLUSION:\n")
cat("Sample size needed:", n_final, "participants\n")
cat("Method: Normal approximation with exact z = 1.96\n")
cat("Formula: n = (z^2 × p × (1-p)) / ME^2\n")
cat("Rounding: Upward (ceiling) to ensure achievement of precision target\n")

# JSON output
library(jsonlite)
result_json <- toJSON(list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_final, unit = "participants_total")
  )
), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", result_json, "\n")
